entries.descriptionOriginal:
👑 EVERY OUTFIT YOU MAKE IS SENT TO CATALOG AVATAR OUTFITS!

No requirements, no grinding. Any outfit you put real effort into is automatically ported over to CATALOG AVATAR OUTFITS, where you can look at it whenever you want:

https://www.roblox.com/games/86145498709536/Catalog-Avatar-Outfits

⏳ Heads up: imports can take a while. Runway runs far higher CCU than Shopping, so there's a large backlog

💃 Avatar Runway is a social fashion runway game where players vote on themes, design avatar looks, walk the runway, rate outfits, and compete for the top podium spots.

✨ Create your own style, build the best look for each theme, use catalog items and emotes, and show off your outfit in front of other players.

🗳️ Vote for the next theme and watch every round become a new fashion challenge.

🏆 Compete with friends and other players to earn wins, climb the leaderboards, and become the top runway model.

✅ Purchased items are added to your Roblox inventory and can be used across Roblox

entries.descriptionOriginal:
SARAB is inspired by real events, with some fictional elements added to make the experience more exciting and suspenseful.

Abu Abdullah asks you to help his son after his condition mysteriously changes.

But every clue you find leads to something more dangerous... and the closer you get to the truth, the harder it becomes to turn back.

Face challenging puzzles, intense chases, and strange creatures as you uncover the truth for yourselves.

🎮 1–4 Players  
📱 Available on Mobile, PC, and Console  
🔀 Features 3 Different Endings

**سراب | SARAB Horror**
